events.title: Brisbane Open House 2026 — Architecture Tours, Talks & Walks
events.description: An annual event opening 93 significant buildings across Brisbane, offering guided tours, public talks, hands-on workshops, and unique access to architectural and construction sites, fostering community engagement with design and history.

events.title: Brisbane Open House — Talks, Walks & Workshops
events.description: As part of Brisbane Open House, this program offers guided walks on flood-resilient urban design, a conversation on GOMA's anniversary, a live bronze pour workshop at UAP Foundry, and special access tours to Cross River Rail construction.

events.title: The Red Dress Exhibition
events.location: Museum of Brisbane, City Hall, CBD
events.description: An ongoing exhibition showcasing Kirstie Macleod's global community art project, The Red Dress, which connects communities through collaborative textile art. It's a thought-provoking display of creative, community-driven work.

events.title: QSO: Ravel & MacMillan
events.description: The Queensland Symphony Orchestra performs Ravel's Daphnis and Chloé ballet score and James MacMillan's First Percussion Concerto, offering an evening of vibrant musical colour, rhythm, and emotion.

events.title: Queensland Ballet: Hamlet
events.description: Queensland Ballet presents a gripping dance drama of Shakespeare's Hamlet, choreographed by Leo Mujić. This is a visually stunning and emotionally resonant theatrical experience.

events.title: Opera Queensland: Rusalka
events.description: Opera Queensland performs Rusalka, a shimmering fairytale of love and sacrifice. This is a lavish and emotionally rich operatic production from one of Australia's leading companies.

events.title: Carlos Bárcenas & John Woods: Alma Latina!
events.description: Colombian tenor Carlos Bárcenas and John Woods present an intimate and vibrant evening, bringing the passion and rhythm of Latin America to life through expressive live performance.

events.title: UQ: Educational Media Production Workshop
events.description: This workshop at UQ helps participants discover how to enhance teaching and learning through video, animation, and visual media, covering media options, practical self-production, and insights from academic developers.

events.title: UQ RD Milns Antiquities Museum: The Odyssey Film Screening
events.description: The RD Milns Antiquities Museum presents a special screening of Christopher Nolan's cinematic reimagining of The Odyssey, held at New Farm Cinemas, including a complimentary drink and Greek sweets on arrival.

events.title: Steve Irwin Memorial Lecture: From Steve's Vision to Scientific Discovery
events.description: Terri Irwin AM, Bindi Irwin, and Professor Craig Franklin deliver a lecture on 20 years of crocodile research, followed by exclusive after-hours access to the Queensland Museum's Croc! exhibition, offering a rare public science and conservation talk.

events.title: QAGOMA: 'kith and kin' by Archie Moore
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Bank
events.description: Archie Moore's 'kith and kin' at GOMA offers an immersive experience with extensive drawing that connects all human ancestors with nature, emphasizing kinship responsibilities to our surroundings.

events.title: Queensland Museum — Curator/Scientist Talks & Tours
events.description: A regular program of public talks and guided tours where curators, scientists, and researchers share fascinating stories behind Queensland Museum's treasured objects and their work.

events.title: Queensland Symphony Orchestra — Music of Video Games
events.description: Experience unforgettable video game soundtracks, from Assassin's Creed to Sonic the Hedgehog, performed with symphonic force by the Queensland Symphony Orchestra, bridging gaming and classical music for a wide audience.

events.title: SLQ Heritage Talk: 150 Years of the Ekka
events.location: State Library of Queensland, South Bank
events.description: This Heritage Talk explores 150 years of the Royal Queensland Show (Ekka), tracing its evolution from an agricultural exhibition to a major annual event that reflects Queensland's social and agricultural history, presented by Ekka fellows.

events.title: QAGOMA — Guided Tours & Wellbeing Sessions
events.cost: Free (some workshops may have a fee)
events.description: QAGOMA offers a daily program of guided tours through its exhibitions and diverse wellbeing sessions, providing engaging ways to connect with art and foster personal reflection.
